package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for get_raw_data_then_should_bindjson_duplicate_body: Gin handlers that read GetRawData() and later bind JSON from the same request body.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
type Rule315PositiveInput struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func scenario315Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	raw, err := c.GetRawData()
	if err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	_ = raw

	var input Rule315PositiveInput
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&input); err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, input)
}
